identity.name: Social Cinema
identity.description: A Letterboxd-style social platform for YouTube video curation.
identity.archetype: The Curator (Dark, Premium, focused on Content)
design_principles: Content First: Video thumbnails are the heroes.
High Contrast: Text must pop against dark backgrounds.
Tactile Feedback: Ratings should feel physical (haptics + gestures).
Social Density: Show friend activity clearly but without clutter.

colors.theme_strategy: Dark Mode First (Cinematic default), Light Mode optional

primary.description: Rose 600 - distinct from YouTube Red but keeps the passion.

secondary.description: Violet 600 - for social actions and friend indicators.

VideoCard.description: Main feed item. Large thumbnail, title below, rating overlay.

StarRating.interaction: Pan gesture (slide finger to fill stars). Haptic feedback on each star step.
StarRating.visual: 5 stars. Empty state: opacity 0.3. Filled state: Primary Color. Size: 32px touch target.

navigation.modal_style: Bottom Sheet / Card Overlay. Keeps home visible in background (opacity 0.5).

universal_guidelines.tech_stack: React Native (Expo), StyleSheet.create, React Navigation / Expo Router
universal_guidelines.theme_handling: Use a React Context (ThemeContext) to toggle between light/dark. Pass theme colors to styles.
universal_guidelines.accessibility: Touch targets minimum 44x44px. Text contrast must pass WCAG AA.
universal_guidelines.performance: Use FlashList (Shopify) for feeds instead of FlatList if possible. Optimize images.
layout_rules: Avoid absolute positioning for main layout. Use Flexbox.
Modal must be a transparent overlay over the Home screen.
universal_guidelines.testing: Add testID to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, list items).

instructions_to_main_agent: Initialize React Native Expo project structure if not present.
Set up ThemeContext immediately for Dark/Light toggle.
Create the Bottom Tab Navigator as the main shell.
Create a 'Add Video' modal that can extract YouTube ID from pasted URL.
Implement the Star Rating component with PanResponder for sliding interaction.
Use the placeholder images for the initial MVP feed.
